description: Single-step DME synthesis over bifunctional catalyst (methanol synthesis + dehydration). Equilibrium conversion and DME selectivity as functions of T, P.

unit.name: Generic CuO-ZnO-Al2O3/NaHZSM-5 bifunctional catalyst, 250-280 degC, 30-50 bar
unit.source: Ereña et al. (2005) Catal. Today 107-108:467; García-Trenco et al. (2018) ACS Catal. 8:4660; Naik et al. (2011) Fuel 90:3266.

T_opt.note: Optimal conversion temperature (equilibrium optimum for direct DME, Ereña 2005)

X_max.note: Maximum CO conversion fraction (single-pass, bifunctional catalyst at 30-50 bar)

k_T.note: Gaussian temperature width (wider than FT: DME synthesis tolerates broader T range)

P_exp.note: Pressure exponent for conversion (Le Chatelier favors DME at high P)

S_DME_max.note: Maximum DME selectivity (vs MeOH by-product; 85-95% in single-step, Naik 2011)

k_S.note: Gaussian width for selectivity vs T

T_S_opt.note: Temperature for maximum DME selectivity (dehydration favored at 250-280 degC)

H2_CO_ratio.note: Feed H2/CO ratio (stoichiometric for direct DME: 2CO + 4H2 → DME + H2O)

LHV_DME.note: LHV of DME (CH3OCH3), 28.7 MJ/kg × 46.07 g/mol = 1322 kJ/mol; HHV ~1460 kJ/mol

DH_reaction.note: Exotherm per mol CO: combined reaction ΔH = -204.8 kJ/mol DME / 2 CO = -102.4 kJ/mol CO
